data.one_liner: Encoders and decoders for converting between different data representations.
data.what_it_does: Provides additional Sink, Codec, Decoder, and Encoder types that complement the dart:convert SDK library. It includes utilities for handling less-central conversion APIs and flexible versioning.
use_when: You need additional codecs or converters beyond what dart:convert offers
You are working with data representations like hex encoding or percent encoding
avoid_when: Core dart:convert features are entirely sufficient for your data representation needs
strengths: Acts as an external counterpart to dart:convert for flexible versioning
Provides useful utilities like AccumulatorSink and CodePage
weaknesses: Limited scope restricted to data conversions
